note: No bare `sya-harvester` key exists; the entry stem is the `//sya-harvester` doc key plus :preview/:broadcast/:verify/:etherscan. :sepolia/:sepolia-preview share the stem but target DeploySyaHarvesterSepolia (stories 115/116 Sepolia leg) and are excluded from this entry (cluster context only).
intentComment: Story 122 Script A (sprint sya-antimatter-cutover) - MAINNET SYAHarvester + StableStakerV2 claim unblock (script/DeploySyaHarvesterMainnet.s.sol; runbook docs/SyaAntimatterMainnetCutover.md). Deploys SYAHarvester(OWNER, V4 PoolManager, SYA, Curve Router NG), sets the USDe (USDe->crvUSD->USDC) and DOLA (DOLA/FRAXBP exchange_underlying -> USDC) routes and the ETH/USDC V4 pool, reads them back, then StableStakerV2.setClaimEnabled(true). BEFORE any broadcast (preview and broadcast alike) it checks each exact route payload against the story-052 rules (audit ryv18m5) and dry-runs each route both ways on the fork asserting balance deltas, then smoke-harvests in a snapshot. Resumable: every step is gated on chain state; progress in server/deployments/progress.sya-harvester.1.json. :preview = fork simulation as OWNER, nothing signed or written; :broadcast = backup mainnet-addresses.ts, Ledger m/44'/60'/46'/0/0 (gas price SYA_HARVESTER_GAS_PRICE_WEI, default 0.3 gwei), patcher FILLS SYAHarvester (only once claimEnabled is recorded), :verify, tax ledger; :verify = read-only script/VerifySyaHarvester.s.sol; :etherscan = OPTIONAL, unchained Etherscan source verification of the deployed harvester (a failed Etherscan call never blocks the patcher).

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && export SYA_HARVESTER_GAS_PRICE_WEI=${SYA_HARVESTER_GAS_PRICE_WEI:-300000000} && forge script script/DeploySyaHarvesterMainnet.s.sol:DeploySyaHarvesterMainnet --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price $SYA_HARVESTER_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-sya-harvester.js && npm run sya-harvester:verify && node scripts/ledger-record.js DeploySyaHarvesterMainnet.s.sol 1
broadcast.note: NOT prefixed by :preview; all steps joined by && (patcher/verify/ledger run only on zero exit of the previous step).

etherscan.note: Reads SYAHarvester address from progress.sya-harvester.1.json; constructor args hardcoded (OWNER, PoolManager, SYA 0x0cD353..., Router NG) - SYA literal duplicates the address-book value.

chainIdSource: require(block.chainid == CHAIN_ID) with CHAIN_ID = 1 in run() of both Deploy and Verify

signer.role: OWNER (harvester owner + StableStakerV2/SYA/NFTMinter owner, confirmed on chain @26303964)

forkTest.note: setup-provided fork block for this run is 26303964
